summary: WeatherAPI.com integration testing complete. All 15 backend tests passed (100%). Weather provider successfully replaced from OpenWeatherMap to WeatherAPI.com. Real weather data is being served (is_fallback=false) with all required fields. Frontend displays weather correctly with Clifton city, temperature, condition, humidity, wind speed. Icon mapping to OWM format working correctly (overcast=04d). Caching verified working.

Backend: GET /api/health shows weather_api_configured as true
Backend: GET /api/weather returns real data (is_fallback=false)
Backend: GET /api/weather returns all required fields (temp, temp_min, temp_max, condition, icon, city, humidity, wind_speed, visibility, sunrise, sunset, uv_index, feels_like, precipitation)
Backend: GET /api/weather returns Clifton as city
Backend: GET /api/weather icon is OWM format (04d for overcast)
Backend: GET /api/weather numeric fields have valid values
Backend: GET /api/weather/extended returns current weather with is_fallback=false
Backend: GET /api/weather/extended returns forecast array with multiple days
Backend: GET /api/weather/extended forecast has day, temp_min, temp_max, condition, icon
Backend: GET /api/weather/extended returns hourly array
Backend: GET /api/weather/extended hourly has time and temp fields
Backend: Weather caching works (second call returns cached data)
Backend: .env has WEATHERAPI_KEY, no OPENWEATHER_API_KEY
Backend: server.py uses api.weatherapi.com, no OpenWeatherMap URLs
Backend: Overcast condition maps to 04d icon (cloudy theme)
Frontend: Lobby display shows Clifton, Texas

Response models unchanged - frontend requires zero changes

test_credentials: No authentication required. Admin panel at /admin is open access. WeatherAPI.com key configured in WEATHERAPI_KEY.
context_for_next_testing_agent: WeatherAPI.com integration complete and working. Weather endpoints: /api/weather (current), /api/weather/extended (current + forecast + hourly). Icon mapping function _weatherapi_to_owm_icon() converts WeatherAPI condition codes to OWM format (01d, 02d, 03d, 04d, 09d, 10d, 11d, 13d, 50d). Cache TTL is 15 minutes. Default city is Clifton, Texas from MongoDB settings. WeatherData model has new fields: feels_like, precipitation.
